purpose: Make scientific integrity, provenance, failure preservation, compute recovery, and change-control decisions machine-readable and fail-closed across the Chemistry program.

hard_rules.name: EVIDENCE_IMMUTABILITY
hard_rules.requirement: Completed evidence, failures, HOLDs, raw outputs, and release results must never be silently rewritten or relabeled. Corrections and extensions must be new versioned records that retain the prior state and provenance.

hard_rules.name: SCIENTIFIC_CHANGE_PREAUTHORIZATION
hard_rules.requirement: Any change to physical model, system definition, functional, pseudopotential identity, cutoffs, k-mesh, geometry constraints, convergence threshold, acceptance rule, statistical rule, hypothesis, definition, interpretation, or evidentiary scope requires a versioned protocol frozen before the affected result is observed and explicit user authorization before execution.

hard_rules.name: MECHANICAL_AUTONOMY_WITH_FIREWALL
hard_rules.requirement: Mechanical orchestration, timeout, artifact-routing, parser, packaging, documentation, and reproducibility repairs may proceed automatically only when scientific_settings_changed=false, thresholds_changed=false, hypothesis_changed=false, interpretation_changed=false, kinetic_inputs_changed=false, and acceptance_rule_changed=false. Every such repair must be versioned and logged.

hard_rules.name: NO_POST_RESULT_RETUNING
hard_rules.requirement: A failed numerical, physical, statistical, or reproducibility threshold may not be loosened or redefined after observing the result. A new test may be added only prospectively and must preserve the original failure as failure.

hard_rules.name: FAIL_CLOSED
hard_rules.requirement: Missing provenance, malformed checkpoints, ambiguous parser state, hash mismatch, incomplete computation, or workflow deviation must produce a HOLD or mechanical failure rather than an inferred scientific PASS.

hard_rules.name: NO_AUTOMATIC_NEW_SCIENTIFIC_RUNG
hard_rules.requirement: Automation may continue only within a prospectively authorized scientific scope. A deeper numerical rung, new physical system, new model family, or new hypothesis may not be dispatched automatically unless the governing protocol explicitly preauthorizes it.

hard_rules.name: PROVENANCE_MINIMUM
hard_rules.requirement: Production evidence must retain enough provenance to reconstruct what ran: repository commit, workflow/run identity, protocol hash, executable hash, pseudopotential or model-input hashes, input/output hashes, source-evidence hashes, execution mode, and any restart/checkpoint manifest hashes.

hard_rules.name: INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION_REMAINS_INDEPENDENT
hard_rules.requirement: Optimization or production checkpoint state may be used to continue the same interrupted calculation, but a designated independent reproduction audit must start from the frozen final physical state without inheriting electronic optimizer scratch unless the protocol explicitly defines a different independent test prospectively.

hard_rules.name: EXECUTION_RESOURCE_PARITY
hard_rules.requirement: Changing rank count, parallelization decomposition, solver binary, numerical library path, accelerator mode, or other execution resource capable of changing numerical results requires a parity qualification before it may generate production evidence. Failed execution modes remain excluded unless a new prospective qualification protocol explicitly reopens them.

hard_rules.name: NATIVE_CHECKPOINT_FIRST_FOR_LONG_RUNS
hard_rules.requirement: When a single logical calculation can exceed the queue/job window and the scientific engine supports native restart, production orchestration must use the engine's clean checkpoint/restart mechanism rather than treating an external kill as a checkpoint. The checkpoint must be created by a documented clean-stop mechanism, persisted, hashed, verified before restart, and resumed with the execution invariants required by the engine.

hard_rules.name: NO_UNSALVAGEABLE_REPEAT_AFTER_TIMEOUT_DIAGNOSIS
hard_rules.requirement: After a run demonstrates that a logical calculation may exceed the available job window before reaching the current external checkpoint boundary, another identical unsalvageable production retry is forbidden unless no native or otherwise validated checkpoint path exists and the exception is explicitly authorized.

hard_rules.name: COMPUTE_ACCOUNTING_HONESTY
hard_rules.requirement: Report measured wall-clock time, configured runtime ceilings, CPU-hours, GPU-hours, and unknown/unreconstructed compute separately. Do not convert a partial ledger into a claimed project total. Failed and mechanically wasted compute remains part of the record.

hard_rules.name: RETROSPECTIVE_PROSPECTIVE_FIREWALL
hard_rules.requirement: A frozen retrospective release cannot be rewritten by later prospective calculations. New results may extend, challenge, or supersede prior claims only in a new version with explicit lineage.

hard_rules.name: CHI_SEMANTIC_LICENSE
hard_rules.requirement: Use of chi must record its generator or source equations, exact definition, dimensions, physical interpretation, meaning of chi=1 if any, licensed inferences, and forbidden cross-domain inferences. Algebraic resemblance alone does not transfer physical meaning between domains.

hard_rules.name: SCALAR_MODAL_CONGLOMERATION_SEPARATION
hard_rules.requirement: Scalar chi/stability coordinates, modal or subspace structure, and conglomeration/system-level coupling are complementary evidentiary layers. None may be treated as a substitute for the others, and disagreement among them is reportable evidence rather than something to tune away.

hard_rules.name: INDEPENDENT_FAMILY_COUNTING
hard_rules.requirement: For Barrier Atlas breadth, additional temperatures, pressures, or repeated conditions within one reaction family deepen that family but do not count as additional independent mechanistic families.

hard_rules.name: LITERATURE_EVIDENCE_ACCESS_AND_STATUS
hard_rules.requirement: Final literature evidence should come from published work with independently verified bibliographic identity. Freely accessible journal, institutional-repository, or author-hosted copies may be used. If required numerical evidence is unavailable, the entry must be caveated, refused, or replaced rather than inferred. Unpublished preprints are not final evidence.
